title: Julio92-C/pneuma pipeline parameters
description: Long-read metagenomics of respiratory samples — QC, host removal, taxonomy, contamination, AMR/VF/MGE, priority-pathogen reconstruction and MERIDIAN cohort analysis

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment. Required for an analysis run (not with --build_databases).
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. Required for an analysis run (not with --build_databases). You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

database_options.title: Database options
database_options.description: Build the reference databases inside the pipeline (--build_databases) or reuse a folder built that way (--db_dir).
database_options.help_text: `--build_databases --db_outdir <dir>` runs only the database download (no analysis, no --input) and publishes everything into `<dir>` together with `database_manifest.tsv`. Later runs pass `--db_dir <dir>` to fill --kraken2_db, --taxdump, --host_index, --abricate_db and --database_manifest from it; parameters given explicitly still override. nf-schema cannot express conditional requirements, so the dependencies between these parameters are checked at start-up in PIPELINE_INITIALISATION.

build_databases.description: Download and prepare the databases into --db_outdir and exit; no analysis is run and --input is not needed.

db_outdir.description: Directory that receives the prepared databases and database_manifest.tsv (required with --build_databases).

kraken_release.description: Kraken2 PlusPF release, YYYYMMDD (https://benlangmead.github.io/aws-indexes/k2). Required with --build_databases unless --skip_kraken_download.

taxdump_month.description: NCBI taxdump archive month, YYYY-MM (match the Kraken2 release month). Required with --build_databases unless --skip_taxdump_download.

skip_kraken_download.description: With --build_databases: do not download Kraken2 PlusPF (no manifest row); pass your own --kraken2_db when analysing.

skip_taxdump_download.description: With --build_databases: do not download the NCBI taxdump (no manifest row).

skip_hostile_download.description: With --build_databases: do not fetch the Hostile index (no manifest row); pass your own --host_index when analysing.

skip_abricate_download.description: With --build_databases: do not download the ABRicate databases (no manifest row).

db_dir.description: Analysis mode: folder written by --build_databases. Fills --kraken2_db, --taxdump, --host_index, --abricate_db and --database_manifest that are not given explicitly.

skip_pathogen_download.description: With --build_databases: skip CheckM2, Bakta, AMRFinderPlus, MOB-suite, Medaka model, MLST record and panel reference genomes.

bakta_db_type.description: Bakta database type to download (light ~1.5 GB, full ~40 GB).

checkm2_zenodo_id.description: Zenodo record of the CheckM2 database; unset = the nf-core default (database v3).

preprocessing_options.title: Preprocessing options
preprocessing_options.description: Adapter trimming, read filtering and host removal.

host_index.description: Host reference for Hostile: a FASTA or minimap2 .mmi index (local path or URL). Required unless it can be resolved from --db_dir.

run_porechop.description: Run Porechop_ABI adapter trimming before filtering.

nanoq_min_length.description: Minimum read length (bp) kept by Nanoq.

nanoq_min_qscore.description: Minimum mean read Q-score kept by Nanoq.

min_reads.description: Samples with fewer reads after host removal are flagged LOW_DEPTH and skipped for Bracken.

kraken2_db.description: Kraken2 database: a directory or a .tar.gz archive (local path or URL). Required unless it can be resolved from --db_dir.

taxdump.description: NCBI taxonomy directory containing nodes.dmp and names.dmp, used by Recentrifuge. Required unless it can be resolved from --db_dir.

bracken_level.description: Taxonomic rank at which Bracken re-estimates abundances.

bracken_threshold.description: Minimum number of reads required for Bracken to consider a taxon.

bracken_read_length.description: Read length matching a database<N>mers.kmer_distrib file in the Kraken2 database.

functional_options.title: Functional profiling options
functional_options.description: ABRicate settings for AMR, virulence and plasmid detection on classified reads.

abricate_db.description: Directory of current ABRicate databases (card/, vfdb/, plasmidfinder/ subfolders), as written by --build_databases (or bin/prepare_databases.sh) to <db_outdir>/abricate. Passed to abricate as --datadir. Unset: taken from --db_dir when present there, else the databases bundled in the container (dated 2021-Mar-27).

abricate_minid.description: Minimum percent identity for ABRicate hits.

abricate_mincov.description: Minimum percent coverage for ABRicate hits.

meridian_options.title: MERIDIAN options
meridian_options.description: Cohort-level statistics and figures via the MERIDIAN container.

skip_meridian.description: Skip the MERIDIAN cohort analysis stage.

meridian_metadata.description: Sample metadata CSV with a `sample` column matching the samplesheet (required unless --skip_meridian).

meridian_group.description: Metadata column holding the comparison groups (required unless --skip_meridian). Comma-separated list (e.g. `sample_type,treatment`) runs one MERIDIAN comparison per column, in parallel, each published to `meridian/<column>/`. Every column must exist in the metadata and have at least 2 distinct non-NA levels among the non-control samples.

meridian_random_effect.description: Optional metadata column used as random effect (e.g. patient ID) for repeated samples.

meridian_study_id.description: Study identifier written into the MERIDIAN config.

meridian_container.description: MERIDIAN container image (single place to bump the MERIDIAN version).

database_manifest.description: Optional TSV describing database versions/checksums; copied to pipeline_info/database_manifest.tsv. Taken from --db_dir when unset.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

pathogen_options.title: Pathogen reconstruction options
pathogen_options.description: Per sample x panel species: Kraken2 read extraction, coverage gate, Flye/Medaka, CheckM2/QUAST, skani, MLST/AMRFinderPlus/ABRicate/Bakta, patient-level pooling.

pathogens.description: Run pathogen reconstruction and the pathogen report. Opt-in: off by default; pass --pathogens to turn it on (this needs the pathogen databases, see docs/usage.md).

pathogen_panel.description: Pathogen panel CSV (species,tier,who_category,action,reference_accession,confusable_with,ani_min[,amrfinder_organism]). Species are names, resolved against --taxdump. Default: the bundled assets/pathogen_panel.csv file.

panel_references.description: Reference accession per panel species and confusable (species, accession, role). Default: the bundled assets/panel_references.tsv file.

pathogen_min_reads.description: PROVISIONAL. Sample x species with fewer Kraken2 clade reads are reported LOW_COVERAGE without extraction.

gate_min_depth.description: PROVISIONAL. Coverage gate: minimum mean depth over the panel reference.

gate_min_breadth.description: PROVISIONAL. Coverage gate: minimum fraction of the reference covered >= 1x.

flye_mode.description: Flye read mode (--nano-hq for R10.4.1 sup/hac reads).

flye_meta.description: PROVISIONAL. Run Flye with --meta (uneven coverage of extracted / pooled reads).

medaka_model.description: Medaka model name; its file is staged from --db_dir/medaka/ or --medaka_model_path.

run_mobsuite.description: Also run MOB-suite mob_recon on typed assemblies (needs the MOB-suite database).

mixed_min_depth.description: Mixed-strain check: minimum depth of an evaluable site.

mixed_min_maf.description: Mixed-strain check: minimum minor-allele frequency of a site.

mixed_min_alt.description: Mixed-strain check: minimum minor-allele reads (seen on both strands).

mixed_max_het_per_kb.description: PROVISIONAL. Mixed-strain check: maximum minor-allele sites per kb before a patient-level assembly is called MIXED_STRAINS.

mixed_min_evaluable.description: Mixed-strain check: fewer evaluable sites gives 'not_evaluable' (noted, not blocking).

checkm2_db.description: CheckM2 DIAMOND database (.dmnd). Default: checkm2/*.dmnd in --db_dir.

bakta_db.description: Bakta database directory (db or db-light). Default: bakta/db* in --db_dir.

mobsuite_db.description: MOB-suite database directory (mob_init). Default: mobsuite/ in --db_dir. Needed with --run_mobsuite.

medaka_model_path.description: Medaka model file (<model>_model_pt.tar.gz). Default: medaka/<--medaka_model>_model_pt.tar.gz in --db_dir.

panel_references_dir.description: Directory with <accession>.fna.gz for every accession in --panel_references. Default: panel_references/ in --db_dir.
